description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractSubscriptions' that manages subscriptions for a publish-subscribe system, including tracking subscribers, topics, and filters. It provides mechanisms for subscribing, unsubscribing, removing subscribers, and creating snapshots of subscription data. The class makes use of Akka ActorRefs and employs Java Stream API for data manipulation.

classes.name: AbstractSubscriptions
classes.description: An abstract class managing subscription mappings between actors, topics, and filters, supporting subscription operations and maintaining consistency.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Allows a subscriber (ActorRef) to subscribe to a set of topics with a specified filter.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber's subscription to specified topics.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions associated with a subscriber.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a subscriber has an active subscription.

methods.name: countTopics
methods.description: Returns the total number of topics currently subscribed to.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates an immutable snapshot of the current subscription state.
